speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

The normal MRI results effectively rule out a stroke, and your history of brief, spontaneous episodes of vertigo resolving quickly without hearing loss or neurological deficits is classic for BPPV. Since the diagnosis is now clear, I will proceed with the Epley maneuver to treat your condition.
